about: The course of an investigation as its researcher lived it, up to now: its requests and what they were answered, its models, the verdicts of its checks and the help it was given. The measurements are facts of that course.

nowhere.definition: its latest checks in a row where its model held in no place

models.definition: distinct models among its latest proposals

regressions.definition: episodes of earlier checks that scored lower with its newer models

looking.definition: answers of its latest round that only looked, in a round with no experiment

composition.source: (p, m) => { const o = m.observations, round = o.round; const checks = p.events.filter((e) => e.type === 'check').map((e) => e.id).slice(-3); const investigations = p.events.filter((e) => e.type === 'investigation' && e.round === round).map((e) => e.id).slice(-3); const given = p.state.given || {}; const silent = (reason) => ({ guidance: { kind: 'abstain', reason }, state: p.state }); if (p.state.round === round) return silent('it advised already in this round'); const fresh = (t) => !(t in given) || round - given[t] > 2; const advise = (focus, template, args, evidence) => fresh(template) ? { guidance: { kind: 'advise', focus, template, arguments: args, evidence, judgments: [] }, state: { round, given: { ...given, [template]: round } } } : null; const pick = (o.regressions > 0 && checks.length >= 2 && advise('contrast', 'regression', { episodes: o.regressions }, checks)) || (o.nowhere >= 2 && o.models <= 1 && checks.length && advise('reframe', 'one_idea', { checks: o.nowhere }, checks)) || (o.nowhere >= 2 && checks.length && advise('contrast', 'discriminate', { checks: o.nowhere }, checks)) || (o.looking >= 3 && investigations.length && advise('develop', 'predict', { answers: o.looking }, investigations)); return pick || silent('no sign in its course that calls for advice it has not given in the last two rounds'); }

regression.text: Your newer models score lower on {{episodes}} episode(s) of earlier checks than your older ones did: find which change lost them before you change anything else, and keep a version that holds both.

one_idea.text: Your model has held nowhere in your last {{checks}} checks, and your recent models are variants of one: write down an alternative mechanism, and an observation where the two would differ.

discriminate.text: Your model has held nowhere in your last {{checks}} checks: before the next change, name the explanations still open and run the observation that tells them apart, with what you expect under each.

predict.text: This round you have looked {{answers}} times without an experiment: write what your current model predicts somewhere you have not looked, and run the experiment that checks it.

provenance.reason: A first situated candidate (SPEC-METAPOLITICA-INVESTIGACION M3), written from the seeds of CATALOGO-METAPOLITICAS-INVESTIGACION (localize-regression, reframe-representation, discriminate-alternatives, develop-prediction) and the stuck signals of the orchestrator. Code only: facts of the course, no judgments; at most one piece of advice a round. A hypothesis about method, to be contrasted in trials. The same advice is not repeated within two rounds: read against the record of a junior that held nowhere for many rounds, it would otherwise have said the same thing every round.
provenance.domain_knowledge: none: no world is named, no solution of the experience worlds is in its words
